- This audit never started, correctly: it is gated on #3231 Phases 1–2 landing, and **all four gating issues are still OPEN** — Phase 1: #3196, #3146; Phase 2: #3192, #3187. Design epic #3231 is OPEN. This issue's own fix packet (task 4733) sits parked on exactly that gate.

- Queue state explains the stall. - **task 5758** — fix #3187 (home_declared `world_id` bound + duplicate endpoints), dedupe key `repo-health:v1:fix:developing-today/code:issue:3187`, status queued.

## Stopping-point diagnosis (2026-11-01)

This checkout contains no partial implementation to resume. Branch `fix/id-3232` is clean at `a9e976ac245d94682ff7ada8dd5562cc58c9b00f`, identical to `origin/fix/id-3232`; `git log origin/main..HEAD` is empty. At inspection it was 62 commits behind `origin/main` (`927f3830742078c50254b7eb23ec9eb8ce9026ba`), so it must be brought up to date with a merge commit before an eventual PR. There are no issue-specific commits and no PR for head `fix/id-3232` or linked directly to #3232/#3231.

There is now PR [#3841](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/3841) linked to the four prerequisite issues. It is **design-only**, not a gate-fix PR: branch `design/id-3231`, head `74a2546549aae277052a521495083dceed713ae5`, base `main`, and its sole changed file is `doc/2026-11-01_design_id3231.md`. Its body explicitly says no implementation code changed and describes Phase 3 (#3232) as gated on Phases 1–2. It therefore does not clear the gate.

Prior work stopped at triage/routing, not code. Task 4733 remained parked on the Phase 1–2 gate. The latest triage note says the audit never started; task 5724 found packets missing for #3146 and #3187 and queued tasks 5756 and 5758 (tasks 5661 and 5660 already covered #3196 and #3192). No audit evidence, contract change, or tests were produced. See [the triage diagnosis](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/3232#issuecomment-6560753607).

At this checkout's HEAD, `pkgs/id/src/artifact.rs:1-20` documents unknown-kind forward compatibility but lacks the requested receipt-contract statement. The untouched validation baseline is at `artifact.rs:275-309` (`check()`), `artifact.rs:318-390` (`parsed()`), and `artifact.rs:425-478` (`ArtifactLog::store()`). For example, `friend_remove.requests` and `home_declared.world_id` are in `artifact.rs:320-354`; the existing triage separately records the corresponding current-main spot-check. These are baseline evidence, not audit dispositions.

## Blocker / what unblocks this

A fresh GitHub check at 2026-11-01 17:02 UTC shows **#3196, #3146, #3192, and #3187 all open**, all assigned to @dezren39, and all linked to design-only PR #3841; none has an implementation PR. The acceptance criterion explicitly prohibits starting Phase 3 until those prerequisite fixes land. Therefore I have not begun the field-by-field audit, edited the contract, run tests, committed, or opened a PR. The gate unblocks when the four fixes land and all four issues close; then merge current `main` into this branch and proceed. Any decision to waive the gate belongs to the design/issue owner, not this implementation branch.
